input.summary: Extend licence grant to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and conformed the access restriction accordingly, since our playbook requires operational use by affiliates and contractors rather than employees only. If preferred, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to Licensor.

ops.oldText: grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use
ops.newText: grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use

ops.oldText: by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee for use in the Field of Use.
ops.newText: by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf, in each case for use in the Field of Use.
